events.evidence: A ceasefire to military operations in the 2011–2012 Syrian uprising comes into effect

The Philippines sends another ship to join the current ship it has involved in a confrontation with two Chinese surveillance ships on the South China Sea

label.note: Syria ceasefire and strong tech earnings supportive; maritime tensions cap risk appetite.
